name: Extended Marching Cubes with Error Information
aliases: Extended Marching Cubes Algorithm with Error Information
definition: An extension of the standard marching cubes algorithm that incorporates local error information (from wavelet transformation) into the iso-surface representation, allowing visualization of data reliability.
summary: Extended Marching Cubes with Error Information visualizes data uncertainty by mapping interpolated error values to vertex hue, distinguishing it from standard Marching Cubes by representing geometry reliability.
